organization.name_ja: 株式会社熊本日日新聞社

affected.note: A list of digital edition users as of August 2021. It was publicly viewable from 2024-07-21 10:56 to 2024-07-22 11:58 and was accessed 13 times.

summary.en: Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun said a list of 28,777 digital edition subscribers with names, addresses, phone numbers and email addresses was viewable on the web for about a day after a vendor misconfigured the environment during a server migration. The file was accessed 13 times before it was taken down.
summary.ja: 熊本日日新聞社は、電子版サーバの移行時に委託先ベンダーが環境設定を誤り、電子版利用者28,777人分の氏名、住所、電話番号、メールアドレスを含む名簿が約1日間ウェブ上で閲覧可能になり、13回アクセスされたと公表した。

sources.title: 電子版会員の個人情報がウェブから閲覧可能に - 熊本日日新聞
